questions.question: If alpha and beta are the zeros of the polynomial f(x) = ax^2 + bx + c, then the value of 1/alpha + 1/beta is:

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: 1/alpha + 1/beta = (alpha + beta) / (alpha * beta). Since alpha + beta = -b/a and alpha * beta = c/a, the ratio is (-b/a) / (c/a) = -b/c.

hi.question: यदि अल्फा और बीटा बहुपद f(x) = ax^2 + bx + c के शून्यक हैं, तो 1/अल्फा + 1/बीटा का मान है:

options.D: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक

hi.explanation: 1/अल्फा + 1/बीटा = (अल्फा + बीटा) / (अल्फा * बीटा)। चूंकि अल्फा + बीटा = -b/a और अल्फा * बीटा = c/a, अनुपात (-b/a) / (c/a) = -b/c है।

questions.question: If the sum of the roots of the equation kx^2 + 2x + 3k = 0 is equal to their product, then k is:

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Sum = -2/k, Product = 3k/k = 3. Given -2/k = 3 => 3k = -2 => k = -2/3.

hi.question: यदि समीकरण kx^2 + 2x + 3k = 0 के मूलों का योग उनके गुणनफल के बराबर है, तो k है:

options.D: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक

questions.question: The solution of the equations 0.4x + 0.3y = 1.7 and 0.7x - 0.2y = 0.8 is:

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Multiply first eq by 2 and second by 3: 0.8x + 0.6y = 3.4 and 2.1x - 0.6y = 2.4. Adding gives 2.9x = 5.8 => x = 2. Then 0.4(2) + 0.3y = 1.7 => 0.3y = 0.9 => y = 3.

options.D: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक

questions.question: If x^2 + 1/x^2 = 27, then the value of x - 1/x is:

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: (x - 1/x)^2 = x^2 + 1/x^2 - 2 = 27 - 2 = 25. So x - 1/x = 5 or -5. Since both A and B are possible, D is the answer.

questions.question: The zeros of the quadratic polynomial x^2 + 99x + 127 are:

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Since all coefficients (a, b, c) are positive, the sum of roots (-b/a) is negative and product (c/a) is positive. This implies both roots must be negative.

hi.question: द्विघात बहुपद x^2 + 99x + 127 के शून्यक हैं:

options.D: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक

hi.explanation: चूंकि सभी गुणांक (a, b, c) धनात्मक हैं, मूलों का योग (-b/a) ऋणात्मक है और गुणनफल (c/a) धनात्मक है। इसका तात्पर्य है कि दोनों मूल ऋणात्मक होने चाहिए।

questions.question: For what value of p does the pair of equations 4x + py + 8 = 0 and 2x + 2y + 2 = 0 have a unique solution?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: For unique solution, a1/a2 != b1/b2. So, 4/2 != p/2 => 2 != p/2 => p != 4.

questions.question: If alpha, beta are the zeros of x^2 - 6x + k = 0 and 3*alpha + 2*beta = 20, then k is:

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: alpha + beta = 6. Multiply by 2: 2*alpha + 2*beta = 12. Subtracting from 3*alpha + 2*beta = 20 gives alpha = 8. Then beta = -2. k = alpha * beta = 8 * (-2) = -16.

hi.question: यदि अल्फा, बीटा x^2 - 6x + k = 0 के शून्यक हैं और 3*अल्फा + 2*बीटा = 20 है, तो k है:

options.D: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक

questions.question: If x = 1 is a common root of the equations ax^2 + ax + 3 = 0 and x^2 + x + b = 0, then ab is:

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Put x=1 in first eq: a+a+3=0 => 2a=-3 => a=-3/2. Put x=1 in second eq: 1+1+b=0 => b=-2. So ab = (-3/2)(-2) = 3.

hi.question: यदि x = 1 समीकरणों ax^2 + ax + 3 = 0 और x^2 + x + b = 0 का एक उभयनिष्ठ मूल है, तो ab है:

options.D: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक

questions.question: If the sum of first p terms of an AP is q and the sum of first q terms is p, then the sum of first (p+q) terms is:

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Standard property: If S_p = q and S_q = p, then S_{p+q} = -(p+q).

hi.question: यदि किसी AP के पहले p पदों का योग q है और पहले q पदों का योग p है, तो पहले (p+q) पदों का योग है:

options.D: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक

hi.explanation: मानक गुण: यदि S_p = q और S_q = p, तो S_{p+q} = -(p+q) होता है।

questions.question: The degree of the polynomial (x + 1)(x^2 - x - x^4 + 1) is:

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: The highest power comes from x * (-x^4) which is -x^5. So the degree is 5.

hi.explanation: उच्चतम घात x * (-x^4) से आती है जो -x^5 है। अतः घात 5 है।

questions.question: If roots of x^2 - bx + c = 0 are two consecutive integers, then b^2 - 4c is:

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Let roots be n and n+1. Difference of roots |alpha - beta| = 1. We know |alpha - beta| = sqrt(D)/a. So 1 = sqrt(b^2 - 4c)/1 => b^2 - 4c = 1.
